title: Self-Powered Day by Month
app: Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ, SolarEdge, Sense, Emporia Vue, DSMR / P1 smart meters, and utility tariff exports collected via vendor APIs, Home Assistant, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=powerwall:aggregate
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(eval(if(grid_kw>0,grid_kw,0))) as import_kw by _time
| eval self_powered_day=if(import_kw<15,1,0)
| where self_powered_day=1
| sort - _time
description: Uses Powerwall aggregate telemetry telemetry to monitor which days stayed almost entirely self-powered in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for months that are quietly improving energy independence, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Powerwall aggregate telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily table of near self-powered days.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which days stayed almost entirely self-powered so you can spot months that are quietly improving energy independence before it becomes annoying.
